Committee: Ways and Means Education
Sponsor: Brown (C)
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 03/01/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 190 as introduced allows the Public School and College Authority (PSCA) to use proceeds from the sale of bonds issued by the PSCA to pay for the cost of constructing, altering, improving, and equipping buildings and other facilities of the Dauphin Island Sea Lab for public educational purposes. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Bill Poole, Chair
Ways and Means Education

Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Ledbetter
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 03/04/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 223 as passed the House of Representatives authorizes the governing body of Class 7 municipalities to pay members of its utility boards a director's fee, in an amount set by the governing body, which could increase or decrease the obligations of the municipality by an undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in the compensation set by the governing body and the compensation otherwise received by the board members. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs
